title: Aggregate dashboard
prompt: Implement `static (int Count, int Total, double Average) Stats(IEnumerable<int> nums)` (empty/null → (0, 0, 0.0)), `static bool AllPositive(IEnumerable<int> nums)` (empty → true — vacuous truth), and `static int FirstBig(IEnumerable<int> nums, int threshold)` — first element > threshold or -1 when none.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: The three collapse families: whole-set stats, a universal predicate, a first-match.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: Empty contracts are explicit: zeroed stats, vacuous true, -1 sentinel.
